# Night Shift case book

<!-- generated by build.mjs from src/engine/casebook.mjs. Do not edit. -->

Every condition in the game. Generated from the same data the simulation runs on.

> Spoilers. These are the answers.

## Anterior STEMI

**Arrives as:** "Chest pain, STEMI alert" by ambulance. **ESI 1.** **Safe beds:** Resus / trauma bay, Acute bed.

| Step | Needs | Minutes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 12-lead ECG and physician assessment | ED physician, ED nurse | 6 |
| Primary PCI in the cath lab | Cath lab, Interventional cardiology, ED nurse | 50 |
| Coronary care (ICU) bed | ICU bed | until a bed is free |

**Time targets:** Door to ECG, 10 min. Door to balloon, 90 min.

**Charge tip:** The cath team is on call at night. Call them in the moment EMS pre-alerts, not when the patient arrives.

## Blunt polytrauma, hemorrhagic shock

**Arrives as:** "Fall from height, hypotensive" by ambulance. **ESI 1.** **Safe beds:** Resus / trauma bay.

| Step | Needs | Minutes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Primary survey, chest tube, massive transfusion | ED physician, Trauma surgeon, ED nurse, Respiratory therapist, 4 units of blood | 15 |
| Damage-control laparotomy | Operating room, Trauma surgeon, Anesthesiologist, ED nurse, 4 units of blood | 75 |
| Surgical ICU bed | ICU bed | until a bed is free |

**Time targets:** Arrival to OR, 60 min.

**Charge tip:** He needs the OR, a surgeon, an anesthesiologist and a nurse at the same moment. One missing piece and he waits holding the trauma bay.

## Opioid overdose (fentanyl)

**Arrives as:** "Unresponsive, slow breathing" by ambulance. **ESI 1.** **Safe beds:** Resus / trauma bay, Acute bed.

| Step | Needs | Minutes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Airway support and IV naloxone | ED physician, ED nurse, Respiratory therapist | 8 |
| Observation for re-sedation | bed only | 75 |
| Discharge with take-home naloxone | ED nurse | 6 |

## Post-operative hemorrhage (ICU inpatient)

**Arrives as:** "ICU patient: drain output rising, hypotensive" already in the hospital. **ESI 1.** **Safe beds:** ICU bed.

| Step | Needs | Minutes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Return to theatre: re-exploration | Operating room, Trauma surgeon, Anesthesiologist, 2 units of blood | 50 |
| Back to an ICU bed | ICU bed | until a bed is free |

**Charge tip:** He holds an ICU bed and needs an OR. If the patient in the OR is waiting for an ICU bed, each holds what the other needs: a bed huddle swaps them in one move.

## Acute ischemic stroke (left MCA)

**Arrives as:** "R weakness, aphasia, stroke alert" by ambulance. **ESI 2.** **Safe beds:** Resus / trauma bay, Acute bed.

| Step | Needs | Minutes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stroke assessment (NIHSS, glucose, IV access) | ED physician, ED nurse | 5 |
| CT head and CT angiogram | CT scanner, Porter | 14 |
| IV thrombolysis | Neurology, ED nurse | 8 |
| Neuro ICU bed | ICU bed | until a bed is free |

**Time targets:** Door to CT, 25 min. Door to needle, 60 min.

**Charge tip:** Brain is lost every minute. A low-acuity scan ahead of her in the CT queue is the wrong queue: expedite her.

## Acute pulmonary edema (heart failure)

**Arrives as:** "Severe shortness of breath" by ambulance. **ESI 2.** **Safe beds:** Acute bed, Resus / trauma bay.

| Step | Needs | Minutes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| BiPAP, IV furosemide, nitroglycerin | ED physician, ED nurse, Respiratory therapist | 15 |
| Portable chest X-ray | X-ray | 8 |
| Telemetry ward bed | Ward bed | until a bed is free |

## Anaphylaxis (peanut)

**Arrives as:** "Throat tightness, hives" walking in. **ESI 2.** **Safe beds:** Resus / trauma bay, Acute bed.

| Step | Needs | Minutes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IM epinephrine and airway watch | Physician assistant or ED physician, ED nurse | 6 |
| Observation for biphasic reaction | bed only | 90 |
| Discharge with auto-injector | ED nurse | 6 |

**Time targets:** Epinephrine within 15 min, 15 min.

**Charge tip:** She walked in, so she starts in the waiting room. Sickest first, not first come first served.

## Suicidal ideation, involuntary hold

**Arrives as:** "Agitation, suicidal ideation" by ambulance. **ESI 2.** **Safe beds:** Behavioural health room, Acute bed.

| Step | Needs | Minutes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Medical clearance, safety search, 1:1 sitter | ED physician, ED nurse | 12 |
| Psychiatric assessment | Psychiatry | 30 |
| Inpatient psychiatric bed | Psychiatric bed | until a bed is free |

**Charge tip:** The psychiatric unit is full until morning. This patient will board: plan the room around that.

## Variceal upper GI bleed

**Arrives as:** "Vomiting blood" by ambulance. **ESI 2.** **Safe beds:** Resus / trauma bay, Acute bed.

| Step | Needs | Minutes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Resuscitation and transfusion | ED physician, ED nurse, 2 units of blood | 14 |
| Emergency endoscopy at the bedside | Gastroenterology, Anesthesiologist, ED nurse | 35 |
| Medical ICU bed | ICU bed | until a bed is free |

**Charge tip:** Endoscopy needs the gastroenterologist, who is at home. Call in early.

## Ruptured ectopic pregnancy

**Arrives as:** "Abdominal pain, vomiting" walking in. **ESI 3.** **Safe beds:** Acute bed, Resus / trauma bay.

| --- | --- | --- |

**Charge tip:** Triage scored her ESI 3 on first look. Watch the waiting room: a rising NEWS score there is a patient in the wrong queue.
